values: Bigsam Global Logistics — Legacy Data Import
Use this workbook to continue from the old Excel records without creating duplicate clients, invoices, or cargo.
Copy old client records into Clients.
Name, email, phone and country code are present.
Invoice number and issuer branch are present.
Currency is derived from the issuer branch.
Each tracking number references an invoice number.
Cargo links to the correct client invoice.
Review valid, duplicate and error rows.
Resolve error rows first when practical.
Valid rows import; duplicates are skipped.
• Keep old invoice and tracking numbers exactly as they were. The importer preserves them for continuity.
• Sales invoices and credit notes are separate invoice types. Credit notes must reference the original invoice number.
• Amount and Amount Paid are numbers. Use ISO dates such as 2026-07-13 and ISO country codes such as NG, GB or CN.
• Shipment movement, airline and container selection happens later in the dashboard, after the invoice and cargo exist.
• The same file cannot be committed twice. Exact existing records are linked or skipped; conflicting identities are stopped for review.
